integrity: The length-eleven Jacobian/Tjurina scheme is established by explicit ideal elimination. Finite-field point counts are exact exhaustive computations and do not certify other extensions. Prior literature and database searches do not prove global novelty.
limitations: Literal integral hypersurface only; no full zeta function, Milnor number, analytic singularity type or stable reduction. The existence of the characteristic-eleven singular point and its rationality consequence are known.
title: A length-\(11\) singular scheme on the characteristic-\(11\) Klein cubic threefold
